correctness.rationale: All quantifiers and parity boundaries are explicit; Walsh eigenvectors diagonalize the fixed graph Laplacian. PBH gives a sharp central-binomial lower bound. Incidence commutator proves harmonic-layer decomposition, and an exact finite-difference coefficient formula is nonzero at all levels. A two-point Hadamard row transform proves even dimension injectivity. Even-middle row complement pairs yield a strict rank obstruction. Reproducible exact checks of 54 eigenspace restrictions, 2309 integer intertwining identities and 2924 nonzero coefficients corroborate the proof without replacing its infinite argument.

value.rationale: The question is natural fixed-Laplacian minimum-coordinate leader placement on all binary hypercubes. The exact all-dimensional optimum is attained by explicit Hamming-layer constructions without an exponential search over input locations. The strict parity obstruction rules out the even central sphere despite its correct size, a structural feature requiring an all-eigenspace rank argument. The construction clarifies and sharply strengthens a single known Q4 case; it is not an arbitrary numerical slice or a small parameter tweak.
